name: ess
description: Write, retrofit, validate and project Executable System Specifications, and hold implementations to them with conformance suites.

interface.shortDescription: Write, retrofit and conformance-test typed ESS specifications.
interface.longDescription: Draft a new ESS domain or retrofit one onto an existing system, validate and compile it, project deterministic JSON Schema and OpenAPI, and raise or audit a conformance suite against a real implementation.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use ess to write, retrofit or conformance-test this system's specification.
